scope: All143 original beforeD protected masks and all15 accepted controlled pairs, original q/L/rawsplit unchanged. Existing saved raster/geometry only; no RGB/features/models/private/current.
main_distance: Euclidean distance from original continuous q to nearest protected native pixel CENTRE. Also report distance to the union of unit native pixel footprints. These are q-to-aux-support diagnostics, not native GT coordinate error.
prespecified_counts: nearest floor(q+.5) pixel inside protected union
sampling_support: four original RGB96 central bilinear samples at q+(+-L/192,+-L/192)
cover_limit: Replay saved resized nearest alpha and fixed cover/sham placement only. Region miss alone is not evidence actual cover misses q. No new candidate/search/fit/label/image construction.
causality: Untouched q neighbourhood may reveal task/operating difference; it does not establish the cause of C2 learning failure.
